names.note: The calendar’s own name page for him is «Иаков (Шестаков), иерей, сщмч.»; the grade and the rank are stripped and the surname kept, the day line itself giving only «Иакова … пресвитеров». `fk.mjs` on the stored string returns NONE.

death.note: The year the day line closes with, «(1918)», which is the whole of what the source gives; no year of birth anywhere.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 10 декабря ст. ст. — «Сщмчч. Иакова и Александра пресвитеров, сщмч. Евграфа пресвитера и сына его мч. Михаила (1918).»

attestations.note: The first of the four one line enumerates, and THE LINE AND THE NAME PAGES ARE ALL THERE IS: no life page stands behind any of the four. The line says «пресвитеров» and his name page «иерей», priest, which agree. `new-martyr` is written as this corpus writes it for this calendar’s twentieth-century «сщмч.» entries. No folder held him: a Cyrillic grep for «Шестаков» over every `saint.json` returns nothing. The company is recorded in `related` and not in the life’s prose, because the calendar says nothing of what joined the four beyond the one line and the one year. The day page prints eleven hymns and none is under any of these names.
